integrity: An integral relative-chain argument proves the module identification; finite signed Lefschetz and mod-two homology checks independently test selected cases without establishing the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: The previously determined ordinary homotopy type is not new. The theorem concerns only the integral homology automorphism lattice of two-hub double stars, not an equivariant wedge decomposition, geometric fixed points, or general trees. Equivalent unpublished work and an independent mathematical audit remain possible.
title: Integral automorphism modules for higher-independence complexes of double stars
